metadata.name: classify comment
metadata.description: Judge one group of comments a scan could not decide without a model, as map_workflow gives it, under the transphobic-harassment policy: write the comment and what it replies to, ask a model, and check its answer. Shown words and descriptions only, never media; what the first model finds uncertain, or hostile only in its context, is judged again by Opus 5.5 before it stands.

metadata.name: Classify comment
metadata.description: Judge whether one comment on her post is hostile, friendly or uncertain under the transphobic-harassment policy, and whether that holds wherever it is posted.

metadata.name: Classify comment again
metadata.description: Judge again, with a stronger model, a comment the first judge found uncertain or hostile only in its context, before the verdict stands.
